title: Heavy Packages Get the Wrong Shipping Rate
description:
`calculate_shipping_cost(weight_kg)` in `shipping.py` should look up the correct rate tier from `rates.py` based on package weight (tiers are inclusive of their upper bound) and multiply by weight. Right now a package weighing exactly at a tier boundary gets bumped into the next, more expensive tier. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`rates.py` — `RATE_TIERS`, a list of `(max_weight, rate_per_kg)` tuples, checked in order
`shipping.py` — looks up the tier and computes the total cost

**Function signature**
`calculate_shipping_cost(weight_kg: float) -> float`
